item.description:
The popover is redesigned around the date:
- Today's Bikram Sambat date is the hero — shown large, with the Gregorian date and weekday beneath it. Today and Convert are now equal tabs. - A header bar carries the app name and the live Nepal Time clock. - A footer bar carries where you are on the left, and Settings, About, and Quit on the right. - The local-time clock appears only when the local zone differs from Nepal Time.
About now states that the licence covers the app code, and that the bundled calendar data is licensed separately.
Note for 1.0 users: this version fixes the updater itself, so 1.0 cannot update in place — please install this one from the DMG. Automatic updates work from 1.1 onward.
